Q1.rationale: The NDA contains no reverse engineering prohibition; it only restricts use, publication, copying and disclosure of Sensitive Information.
Q1.label: NotMentioned

Q2.rationale: Segment 24 requires return of written or tangible materials only if Disclosing Party requests it in writing, not upon termination of the Agreement, so the termination trigger is absent.
Q2.label: NotMentioned

Q3.rationale: The NDA never states that no right or licence to Sensitive Information is granted; it only says the information is held for the Disclosing Party's sole benefit.
Q3.label: NotMentioned

Q4.rationale: No clause makes the existence or negotiation of the Agreement confidential; the integration clause does not address this.
Q4.label: NotMentioned

Q5.rationale: Segments 7-9 define Sensitive Information broadly to include anything with commercial value or security-related information, which is incompatible with a technical-only scope.
Q5.label: Contradiction

Q6.rationale: Segments 10 and 11 require the Disclosing Party to label physical and electronic materials and to confirm oral disclosures in writing, which covers identification of information in all forms, though the labelling duty is not stated for every item.
Q6.label: Entailment

Q7.rationale: Segment 26 states that the non-disclosure provisions survive termination of the Agreement.
Q7.label: Entailment

Q8.rationale: Segment 18(e) excludes information independently developed by the Receiving Party outside the scope of the Agreement, which permits independent development of similar information.
Q8.label: Entailment

Q9.rationale: The NDA has no clause permitting retention of Sensitive Information after return or destruction.
Q9.label: NotMentioned

Q10.rationale: Segment 11 expressly addresses orally transmitted information and treats it as Sensitive Information.
Q10.label: Entailment

Q11.rationale: The NDA contains no non-solicitation covenant regarding Disclosing Party's representatives.
Q11.label: NotMentioned

Q12.rationale: Segment 21 allows access by contractors and third parties as reasonably required, subject to nondisclosure restrictions; consultants and advisors fall within these third-party categories.
Q12.label: Entailment

Q13.rationale: Segment 23 prohibits copying without prior written approval, which implies copying is permitted with such approval; this carve-out allows copying in some circumstances.
Q13.label: Entailment

Q14.rationale: The NDA has no clause requiring notice to Disclosing Party when disclosure is compelled by law, regulation or judicial process.
Q14.label: NotMentioned

Q15.rationale: Segment 16 excludes information legitimately learned from a source other than Disclosing Party from Sensitive Information, which permits acquiring similar information from a third party.
Q15.label: Entailment

Q16.rationale: Segment 21 permits restricted access by employees as reasonably required, subject to nondisclosure restrictions.
Q16.label: Entailment

Q17.rationale: Segments 20 and 23 restrict use of Sensitive Information to the Disclosing Party's benefit and bar use for the Receiving Party's own benefit without approval, which covers use beyond the Agreement's purpose; the purpose is stated in segment 4.
Q17.label: Entailment
